description: This file defines the 'Container' class implementing a dependency injection container for the Revive Adserver project. It manages container initialization, caching, and service configuration.

classes.name: RV\Container
classes.description: A dependency injection container class for managing service configuration, caching, and retrieval within the Revive Adserver project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the container, manages cache, and loads services based on configuration and hostname.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a service or parameter from the container by its ID.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a service or parameter exists in the container by its ID.

methods.name: getConfigCache
methods.description: Returns a ConfigCache object for the specified hostname and delivery mode.

methods.name: rebuildCachedContainer
methods.description: Rebuilds and caches the container PHP class file.

methods.name: initContainerWithParameters
methods.description: Creates a basic container and loads parameters from configuration array.

methods.name: getParametersResource
methods.description: Generates a ContainerParametersResource from configuration array.

methods.name: addServices
methods.description: Adds service configurations to the container, especially for non-delivery mode.
